text:
Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection list I1, which must be performed 
after 4000 operating hours or when Δ P = 0.1 bar as indicated in the above 
titled block
The first draft is initiated by eng. Saad Samra, tested by eng. Mohamed Abdel 
Azeem at 07 July 2003, accepted by by General Manager eng. Mohamed El-Sarrag, 
revised by EDEPCo. quality control eng. Abouda El-Bana, and approved by eng. 
Moneer Mahmoud El-Wakeel Damietta CCPS Head Sector.
Technical Specifications
Initial air flow resistance | 2,7 mbar
Cleaning cycle start | 7 mbar
Cleaning cycle stop | 5 mbar
High pressure drop alarm | 11 mbar
Compressed air pressure | 7 bar
Max temperature | 80 C
Flow | 4,2 
 Nm3 /min
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified 
 maintenance stuff should be carry the
 suitable safety category,
Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area
Wear safety helmets, shoes, earplug 
 and gloves pairs ... etc
Be sure that the filters are out of service.
Open self cleaning system when needed.
Complete maintenance set.
Compressed air hose.
Cleaning articles
Soft brushes.
Magnetic pick-up flexible.
Spray gun
Lifting crane.
Long rope with basket
Vacuum pump.
Work to be Carried Out
Change 25% of the filters every 4000 
 operating hours
Inspect the air filters; replace the 
 damaged if it is required.
Check the system for leaks on a 
 regular base.
Treat any leaks that found with a 
 suitable sealing compound.
Clean the filters automatically by 
 self-cleaning system.
